title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. to Host First Quarter 2012 Earnings Webcast
summary: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. will host an earnings webcast to discuss its first-quarter 2012 results on Friday, May 18, 2012 at 10 a.m. Central time. The live webcast and presentation will be available on Inland American’s website at www.inlandamerican.com. Listeners should log on approximately 10 minutes in advance to ensure proper setup to receive the webcast. A replay will be available on the Inland American website following the webcast. About Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. focuses on acquiring and developing a diversified portfolio of commercial real estate including retail, multi-family, industrial, lodging, office and student housing properties, located in the United States and Canada. The company also invests in joint ventures, development projects, real estate loans and marketable securities.
